CREATE TABLE D360.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB_BU_20240807
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
AS

SELECT * FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB

DELETE FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
WHERE SCD_START_DATE >= CAST('20240729' AS DATE);

--UPDATE RECORDS 20240726
UPDATE EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
SET SCD_END_DATE = CAST('99991231' AS DATE),
ISLATEST = 1, ISACTIVE = 1
WHERE SCD_END_DATE >= CAST('20240728' AS DATE) AND SCD_END_DATE <> CAST('99991231' AS DATE);

CREATE TABLE EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CUST_ID)
)
AS
SELECT BANK_ID
	, BAY_USER_ID
	, BRANCH_ID
	, CORP_USER
	, CUST_BANK_ID
	, CUST_ID
	, CUSTOMER_TYPE
	, DB_TS
	, DEL_FLG
	, GRP_ID
	, R_CRE_ID
	, R_CRE_TIME
	, R_MOD_ID
	, R_MOD_TIME
	, Cast(START_DATE AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm
FROM 
(
	SELECT BANK_ID
		, BAY_USER_ID
		, BRANCH_ID
		, CORP_USER
		, CUST_BANK_ID
		, CUST_ID
		, CUSTOMER_TYPE
		, DB_TS
		, DEL_FLG
		, GRP_ID
		, R_CRE_ID
		, R_CRE_TIME
		, R_MOD_ID
		, R_MOD_TIME
		, isActive
--		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
		, Row_Number() Over (PARTITION BY BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, CORP_USER, CUST_ID 
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) SEQ_NUMBER
		, Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, CORP_USER, CUST_ID 
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  
	FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;

					, CLT_OTHER_NUMBER
					, CLT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
					, CLT_MARITAL_STATUS
					, CLT_MOTHER_MAIDEN_NAME
					, CLT_DOC_ID
					, CLT_ID_PROOF
					, CLT_STS_ID
					, CLT_CREATED_BY
					, CLT_CREATED_TS
					, CLT_UPDATED_BY
					, CLT_UPDATED_TS
					, CLT_AUDIT_LOG
					, CLT_CCL_ID
					, CLT_NATIONALITY
					, CLT_ID_PROOF_DOC
					, CLT_MIDDLE_NAME
					, CLT_WORK_PHONE_NO

				--	, isLatest

				order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO

WHERE SEQ_NO = 1;
